features.name: api-gateway
features.summary: Define and register Kong services, routes, and plugins.
enable_when: The process constructs Kong route definitions.
The process registers or removes services through the Kong Admin API.

features.name: cancellation
features.summary: Propagate structured, scoped cancellation through async work.
enable_when: Async work needs parent-child cancellation.
A future needs timeout or cancel-on-drop behavior.

features.name: config
features.summary: Read the standard Midwess Kong and deployment configuration.
enable_when: Code imports the shared Kong configuration.
Code needs the configured public gateway URL.

features.name: distributed-id
features.summary: Generate Snowflake-style IDs without a coordination service.
enable_when: One process generates IDs with a scoped worker ID.
Code decodes Hero ID timestamps or generates scoped synthetic phone numbers.

features.name: distributed-id-etcd
features.summary: Coordinate distributed-ID worker leases through etcd.
enable_when: Multiple processes must generate IDs without worker-ID collisions.

features.name: env
features.summary: Normalize local, development, staging, and production checks.
enable_when: Code branches on the deployment environment.

features.name: finally
features.summary: Run collected asynchronous cleanup work when an owner drops.
enable_when: An owner needs best-effort async cleanup on drop.

features.name: grpc-gateway
features.summary: Reuse a tonic channel through the configured gateway.
enable_when: A native client calls gRPC services through Kong.

features.name: grpc-server
features.summary: Add tonic incoming-listener support to Hero's TCP pattern.
enable_when: A tonic server uses Hero to bind or select its listening port.

features.name: logger
features.summary: Apply Midwess logging defaults and throttled logging.
enable_when: A process uses the shared logging setup.
Repeated log messages should be aggregated.

features.name: maybe
features.summary: Express target-dependent sendability in generic APIs.
enable_when: A generic API needs native Send/Sync bounds but relaxed WASM bounds.

features.name: never-send
features.summary: Mark a value as intentionally local without faking auto-traits.
enable_when: A wrapper should communicate thread-local ownership.

features.name: number
features.summary: Compute time-based exponential integer growth.
enable_when: A bounded integer should grow exponentially with elapsed time.

features.name: pool
features.summary: Manage bounded reusable resources and waiter queues.
enable_when: Infrastructure resources are expensive to create and safe to reuse.

features.name: retry
features.summary: Retry transient async operations with fixed or capped backoff.
enable_when: An operation has explicitly classified transient failures.

features.name: s3
features.summary: Access S3-compatible object storage with product-neutral paths.
enable_when: A native process reads, writes, signs, or manages multipart S3 objects.

features.name: shell
features.summary: Consume piped child stdout and stderr as one async stream.
enable_when: A native process streams output from a spawned child.

features.name: smtp
features.summary: Send rendered HTML email with delivery cancellation.
enable_when: A native process sends already-rendered email through SMTP.

features.name: stream
features.summary: Create in-memory duplex byte streams.
enable_when: Two async endpoints need a bidirectional in-memory byte transport.

features.name: string
features.summary: Use shared string validation helpers.
enable_when: Code needs the shared email validation extension.

features.name: task
features.summary: Abort an owned Tokio task when its guard drops.
enable_when: A background Tokio task must not outlive its owner.

features.name: tcp
features.summary: Bind dual-stack TCP and UDP listeners without tonic.
enable_when: A native process uses Hero to bind or select a TCP/UDP port.

features.name: throttle-future
features.summary: Coalesce frequent values before asynchronous processing.
enable_when: Only the latest pending value should run after a delay.

features.name: time
features.summary: Read epoch time in microseconds across targets.
enable_when: Code needs one microsecond epoch-time API on native and browser targets.

features.name: token
features.summary: Create and decode HS256 JSON Web Tokens.
enable_when: A native authentication boundary issues or validates HS256 JWTs.

features.name: wasm
features.summary: Use browser HTTP, byte/file, and OPFS helpers.
enable_when: A browser client needs Hero's Fetch/XHR, byte conversion, file metadata, or OPFS helpers.

features.name: yield-container
features.summary: Lend a value temporarily and return it on drop.
enable_when: One owner temporarily lends a value that must be returned automatically.
